title: OpenAI Promised $1 Trillion It Doesn't Have
description:
OpenAI has committed roughly $1 TRILLION to infrastructure — while losing money on its own paying customers.
Burning tens of billions a year, promising a trillion, and trying to IPO at a $1T+ valuation. Make it make sense.
